question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Appropriate
solution: The correct answer is option 2), i.e., 'Improper .' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ • Let's look at the meaning of the given word: • **Appropriate **- suitable or proper in the circumstances. (उचित) • **Improper **- not in accordance with accepted rules or standards. (अनुचित) • ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:​ • **Transparent **- allowing light to pass through so that objects behind can be distinctly seen. (पारदर्शी) • **Salient **- most noticeable or important. (महत्वपूर्ण) • **Disturbing **- causing anxiety or concern; upsetting. (चिंताजनक) • Hence from the given meanings, we find that 'Appropriate ' and 'Improper ' are antonyms. • So, the correct answer is option 2. 40:Tccff,
